title: Sex, Spies and Silicon Valley: OpenAI Warns Staff About "Honey Pots"
hook_text: OpenAI just warned staff about honey pots.
script:
OpenAI just warned employees in Silicon Valley about foreign honey pots and romantic setups.
Foreign intelligence spies are targeting artificial intelligence researchers with fake relationships to steal company secrets.
Attackers deploy these honey pots to access proprietary models, algorithms, and sensitive infrastructure data.
The security memo highlights how foreign actors exploit personal connections to compromise high level personnel.
Tech firms face rising espionage threats as artificial intelligence assets become global geopolitical targets.
Would you spot a romantic honey pot trap at your tech job?
